name: Old Scout
text: You're another Solar Scout, like me.

name: Old Scout
text: Listen, I’m not gonna give you a sob story…

name: Old Scout
text: Or a long tale about how COMPANY doesn’t care about it’s employees

name: Old Scout
text: All I'll say is that you’ll end up like me too

name: Old Scout
text: They learn about the things that COMPANY does…

name: Old Scout
text: They learn that COMPANY doesn’t care…

name: Old Scout
text: Or they just get fed up listening to orders…

name: Old Scout
text: Then they go on one last assignment and don’t come back.

name: Old Scout
text: I’ve been on this Planet for 42 years this planets’ time.

name: Old Scout
text: At least that's as many days the sun has risen and set.

name: Old Scout
text: I don’t know what your expecting from me.

name: Old Scout
text: I’m not gonna tell you to leave COMPANY.

name: Old Scout
text: Go back. You don’t wanna end up like me.
